resources.string: Allows a support technician to control this device while a support session is running
Token issued by the management portal. Redeemed once at first contact and then cleared, so a cloned image cannot enrol twice.

The identifier technicians search this device by. Preferred over the hardware serial, which an ordinary app cannot read on Android 10 and later. Left empty, the client falls back to the hardware serial if it is readable, then to ANDROID_ID.
Management API base URL, for example https://odv.example.com. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.
Rendezvous server host. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.
Relay server host. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.
Deployment public key. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.
